```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

n_before_1 <- 5415
n_before_2 <- 8123

n_after_1 <- 1432
n_after_2 <- 7543

cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before <- c(n_before_1, n_before_2)
n_after <- c(n_after_1, n_after_2)
```

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_favorite_animal<- all_my_pets[1]
print(my_favorite_animal)
```

```{r}
cell <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = treated,
  num_cells_before = n_before,
  num_cells_after = n_after
)
gt(cell)
```
